string-array.name: exam_protocol_steps
string-array.item: Case history — brief demographics and symptom questions (screening only).
Room setup — calibrate on-screen width so letter size approximates a wall chart (still device-dependent).
Optional blur ladder — pick the row that feels closest to your uncorrected blur (illustration only, not a prescription).
Distance visual acuity — each eye tested alone (OD then OS) with the fellow eye fully covered.
Near vision — both eyes at a habitual reading distance.
Supplemental checks — simple astigmatism-style pattern and a contrast comparison task.
Summary — plain-language findings and when to seek in-person care.
